description.text: Program Description The Advantage of Aeronautical Engineering (Aerospace Manufacturing Engineering) Aeronautical Engineering is one of the important majors in the College of Aerospace Engineering, which was founded in November, 2003, set up by the merging of the Department of Aircraft Manufacturing Engineering and the Department of Engineering Mechanics, its predecessor, the Department of Aeronautical Engineering formed in 1978. The College of Aerospace Engineering has a first-level Aerospace Science master's degree and three second-level master's degree programs (Aerospace Manufacturing Engineering, Aircraft Design and Engineering Mechanics), it also has engineering master's degree program in Aeronautical Engineering. Among these Aerospace Manufacturing Engineering is a characteristic discipline developed by the national defense science and industry committee and Liaoning Province; it is also the national defense science and industry committee period program with proper priority second-level discipline. The college of Aerospace Engineering currently has 61 teaching and administrative staffs, of which 8 are professors, 28 are associate professors and 15 have a doctorate degree. There are 1120 undergraduate students, 47 engineering graduate students and 200 students studying a minor at the college. In recent 5 years the collage has undertaken the National Natural Sciences Fund, Aeronautical Science Fund, Liaoning Province Science Fund, the National Defense Advanced Research topic, the National 11 priority projects, SDS unmanned aerial vehicle, some model carrier-borne aircraft and 80 other new machine development topics, research spending have amounted to 15 million Yuan. The college 22 laboratories include Aircraft Design and synthesis lab, fatigue and vibration lab, mold/die lab, forming and fabrication characteristics lab, cold stamping lab, plastic fabrication lab, SPF/DB lab, reverse-engineering lab, airplane board installation and systems lab, aircraft assembly lab, aircraft joining lab, theoretical mechanics lab, materials mechanics; lab and other laboratories and research centers, the college also has Liaoning Province key laboratories - Liaoning Province digital simulation and engineering laboratory.

duration.text: The Aerospace Manufacturing Engineering at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 3. Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Two recommendation letters Candidates for Master degrees will need two letters of recommendation from persons of associate professor status or higher.

requirements.text: All applicants must be in good health. Under the age of 35, a B.S. degree or equivalent qualification, able to take courses in English or in Chinese (reaching the 4th level HSK), two letters of recommendation from persons of at least associate professor status.
